text: An Nulaaɗo maakan yedduɓe deppitiiɓe ɓen e dow geddi muuɗum: "Joomi am haajiraaka e mooɗon fii nafa artanayka Mo sabu ɗoftaare mooɗon nden, sinndo wanaano no tawde woodani Mo jeyaaɓe ɓe no nodda Mo noddandu dewal e toraare O haajetanooke e mooɗon". Gomɗii on fennii Nulaaɗo on e nder kon ko o addani on ɗum immorde ka Joomi mooɗon, aray nde njoɓdi fennugol ngol wona duumiiɗum e mooɗon.
